events.title: Sir 알렉스 퍼거슨 writes off 맨체스터 유나이티드's chances of a unique fourth successive league title triumph after the latest of several defeats sees them lose 3–0 at home to 첼시.
Manager 로날트 쿠만 switches from Dutch club 피테서 to Ajax . He is replaced by former player Edward Sturing .
사우샘프턴 buy striker Brett Ormerod from 블랙풀 for £1.75 million.

맨체스터 유나이티드 lose 1–0 at home to 웨스트햄 유나이티드 , completing a dismal run of six defeats from seven Premiership fixtures, leaving them ninth in the league – 11 points behind leaders 리버풀, who have a game in hand.
After weeks of predominantly dismal results, 맨체스터 유나이티드 get back to their winning ways with a comprehensive 5–0 win over struggling 더비 카운티.
Division One promotion chasers 울버햄프턴 원더러스 sign 레인저스 striker 케니 밀러 for £3 million after a successful loan spell.
빌럼 II fires manager Hans Verèl .
입스위치 타운 record only their second league win over the season by beating 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–1 at White Hart Lane . 맨체스터 유나이티드's revival continues as they beat 사우샘프턴 6–1 at Old Trafford.
리버풀 sign Czech striker AC 밀란 Baroš from Baník Ostrava for £3.5 million.
The highlight of Boxing Day sees 맨체스터 유나이티드 extend their revival and winning run to four games with a 2–0 win at 에버턴.
Andy Cole signs for 블랙번 로버스 in an £8million deal after seven years at 맨체스터 유나이티드.
맨체스터 유나이티드 make it five consecutive league game wins as they beat 풀럼 3–2 at Craven Cottage , with 라이언 긱스 scoring twice.

2001 draws to a close with 아스널 leading the Premier League on goal difference ahead of 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, with third placed 리즈 유나이티드 just a point off the top, while fourth placed 리버풀 are two points off the top with a game in hand. A resurgent 맨체스터 유나이티드 are now fifth and just three points off the top, three weeks after being ninth in the league and 11 points off the top. 번리 continue to lead the way in Division One, a point ahead of their nearest rivals 맨체스터 시티 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스. 노리치 시티, 밀월 and 버밍엄 시티 complete the top six.
